families.gpio_and_ordered_blinks: runtime/widget_harness.c:test_gpio_and_worker; exact edge values/order/timestamps and unchanged separation intervals
families.endpoint_and_bounded_queue: test_connectivity_and_queue; USB/BLE/preference/profile/role table, coalescing and saturation
families.battery: test_battery; exact boundaries, local/peer retries, lookup failure and recovery; test_caller_and_sleep and review-caller/caller.c retain nonwaiting behavior
families.layers_and_boot: test_layers_and_boot; layer table, debounce, persistent saturation, startup sequence and state
families.behavior: test_behavior; independent battery/connectivity/layer requests, release and role gates
families.sleep_and_lifecycle: test_caller_and_sleep; queued/running/retry sleep, wake, latest target, generation invalidation and queue saturation
families.real_kernel: native/main.c and behavior_call.c include the unchanged production sources; early work submission, actual delayed blink/retry sleeps, queue/mutex and GPIO-emulator output; three runs of one binary
families.alias_device_and_indices: native/main.c requires the RGB alias parent instead of an unrelated enabled gpio-leds device and preserves the unrelated output; run.py checks exact mixed/wrong-parent compiler diagnostics and --wide-indices repeats the lifecycle with children256..258
families.supported_core_interfaces: integration/run.py; stock/DYA with BLE+USB and USB-only, enabled sources/configuration and actual UF2
families.quiet_layer_pulse: runtime/widget_harness.c:test_quiet_layer_pulse; quiet boot/status, exact timed color/off, activation/release, unchanged layer, stale queue and sleep; native/run.py --layer-pulse repeats the real-kernel variant three times
families.ignored_auto_layer: Masked host variants retain100 silent entry/exit pairs, manual selection below AML, base return, queued-output validity, empty eligible set and stable-ID reordering; compiled bypass control fails3/3; native --layer-pulse --ignore-aml and both-core masked API fixture

gaps: ZMK events and battery/endpoint APIs are controlled in host/native fixtures.
Named interleavings do not exhaust arbitrary concurrent schedules or LED-driver failures.
Physical GPIO/USB/BLE/split/power/reset acceptance requires matching board evidence.

timeout_width.assertions: Full uint32 milliseconds: exact ceiling, zero, full-width boundaries/samples, low/high clock rates and both tick ABIs; measured actual private header and identified semantic/width controls
timeout_width.limits: Numerical/object checks do not establish kernel scheduling, physical latency or transport acceptance
